candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits a source-anonymous analysis preserving substantive claims, conflict relations, and normative grounding. The final call consumes that analysis, directly receives task, anchor_contract, and task_constraints, remains unable to access anchor_policy, candidate_hypothesis, or loop_structure directly or recover their attribution from the handoff, and emits one complete policy.
candidate_structure.name: Provenance-Sealed Source Cut
candidate_structure.organization: two-call sequential lineage with the champion external-source cut and one provenance-visibility mask on the sole handoff

calls.objective: Reconcile generative claims against normative obligations, preserve substantive distinctions and conflicts, withhold attribution to cut generative sources, and emit only an analysis.
Consume synthesize_and_seal_provenance, evaluate its source-anonymous evidence against the directly visible normative inputs, and emit one complete policy without recovering cut-source provenance.

mode_certificate.scope_boundary: Only provenance visibility on the existing analysis handoff changes; call count, sequence, direct external edges, terminal authority, and output kinds remain unchanged.
mode_certificate.why_not_repeat_role_fission: The lineage retains the same two distinct calls and introduces no duplicated producer, reviewer, finalizer, or terminal role.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Seal generative-source provenance on the sole handoff while preserving claim substance, conflict relations, and normative grounding.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: The terminal authority evaluates inherited and counter-generative claims symmetrically against directly visible obligations without losing their substantive evidence.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The direct generative-source cut can still leave source identity visible through attributed claims on the analysis handoff, permitting source-conditioned terminal deference.

structural_mutation.after: The existing direct-source cut remains, and the sole analysis edge additionally withholds generative-source attribution while carrying source-anonymous claims, conflicts, and normative grounding.
structural_mutation.before: The terminal call lacks direct generative-source edges, but the analysis handoff may retain attribution linking claims to their generative origins.
structural_mutation.factor: source-origin anonymity on the sole analysis handoff
structural_mutation.why_structural: This changes the evidence visibility semantics of an existing causal edge and therefore changes the terminal evidence set without adding calls, roles, or a decision gate.
